The last monarch from Britain’s House of Hanover was **King William IV**.  
He died on **20 June 1837** at Windsor Castle.  After his death, the Hanoverian line continued in the Kingdom of Hanover (his brother Ernest Augustus became king), but the personal union with Britain ended, and Queen Victoria succeeded him on the British throne.  (Source: *Wikipedia – William IV of the United Kingdom*.)
